description.en: Reads a temporary map bit flag. Temporary map bit flags are a table of 32 bits (numbers 0 to 31) in the flag data, meant by their name for the current map.

true if the flag is set, false otherwise (also false if the flag data is not available).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: Something done once on this map (not found in script_clean/; invented)
